# Bangladesh Global Study Abroad Cost & Scholarship Dataset (2027)

Open CC BY 4.0 global higher-education benchmark published by **EduExpress International** (https://eduexpressint.com/press, Dhanmondi, Dhaka, Bangladesh).

## Highlights
- **32-country global Bangladesh outbound matrix** (12 active EduExpress countries + 20 top OECD/regional benchmark destinations) with 2026/27 statutory visa solvency rules
- **416 verified active universities across 12 countries** (China (353), Malaysia (15), United Kingdom (8), Finland (6), Hungary (6), South Korea (6), Cyprus (4), Georgia (4), Greece (4), Thailand (4), Croatia (3), Malta (3))
- **1974 structured degree & language programs** with explicit tuition and medium of instruction
- **737 structured university scholarship rows** + **54 Bangladesh-eligible flagship national scholarships** across all 32 countries
- **1609 itemized non-tuition fee rows** kept strictly separate from tuition

1974 structured degree and language programs with explicit tuition, duration, language, and verification dates.

1609 non-tuition and institutional fee rows (dorms, insurance, residence permit, EMGS, application fees).
32-country global Bangladesh outbound matrix covering tuition, living costs, 2026/27 statutory visa solvency thresholds, AD Bank Student File rules, and work rights.
54 Bangladesh-eligible flagship government, regional, and institutional scholarships across 32 global destinations.
Snapshot of EduExpress China study cost benchmark JSON API.
Snapshot of EduExpress Bangladesh 2027 outbound study abroad market & 32-country benchmark JSON API.
